maintenance_led.reason: Progressive Leasing's lease-to-own financing helps consumers make first-time purchases of furniture, electronics and appliances; not repair or servicing.

publicly_funded.reason: Revenue comes from consumers' lease payments, plus retailer fees and employee payroll deductions, not government payers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Growth is mainly organic through Progressive Leasing's retail partners; Four Technologies and MoneyApp were occasional acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Retailers and consumers can switch to other lease-to-own or BNPL providers fairly easily; Progressive Leasing is a payment option.
